key: It's gone... My darling little Mareep is gone.
en: It's gone... My darling little Mareep is gone.
ja: いなくなっちゃった……私のかわいいメリープが、いなくなっちゃったの。

key: We were separated when a building collapsed and now I can't find it anywhere.
en: We were separated when a building collapsed and now I can't find it anywhere.
ja: 建物が崩れたときに離れ離れになって、どこを探しても見つからないの。

key: What am I going to do? It'll be so afraid, and alone, and I--
en: What am I going to do? It'll be so afraid, and alone, and I--
ja: どうしよう。きっと怖がって、一人ぼっちで、私……

key: Just gotta calm down...
en: Just gotta calm down...
ja: 落ち着かなきゃ……

key: Stop, think...
en: Stop, think...
ja: 待って、考えて……

key: Calm down, and...
en: Calm down, and...
ja: 落ち着いて、それで……

key: Aaah!
en: Aaah!
ja: ああっ!

key: O-oh?
en: O-oh?
ja: あ、あら?

key: Is that...
en: Is that...
ja: それって……

key: You found my darling Mareep?
en: You found my darling Mareep?
ja: 私のかわいいメリープを見つけてくれたの?

key: And it's safe?
en: And it's safe?
ja: 無事なのね?

key: It must have been so scared...
en: It must have been so scared...
ja: きっと、怖かったでしょうに……

key: We could hear the vines in the ward around us, but the damage to our building was minimal-- until it suddenly collapsed!
en: We could hear the vines in the ward around us, but the damage to our building was minimal-- until it suddenly collapsed!
ja: 周りのワードでつるの音が聞こえていたけど、うちの建物への被害は少なかったの――なのに、突然崩れてしまって!

key: I thought I'd never see Mareep again...
en: I thought I'd never see Mareep again...
ja: もう二度とメリープに会えないと思っていたわ……

key: Thank you, trainer-- thank you so much!
en: Thank you, trainer-- thank you so much!
ja: ありがとう、トレーナーさん――本当にありがとう!

key: I've burnt off so much nervous energy-- why don't you take these?
en: I've burnt off so much nervous energy-- why don't you take these?
ja: 気が張りつめてすっかり疲れちゃった――これ、受け取ってくれない?

key: I bought them because they matched Mareep, but I don't think I'll see much use out of them, now.
en: I bought them because they matched Mareep, but I don't think I'll see much use out of them, now.
ja: メリープに似合うと思って買ったんだけど、今はあまり使い道もなさそうだから。

key: \PN received 3 Quick Balls!
en: \PN received 3 Quick Balls!
ja: \PNはクイックボールを3個受け取った!

key: It does get me thinking, though...
en: It does get me thinking, though...
ja: でも、考えさせられちゃったの……

key: Mareep deserves a trainer who can keep it safe.
en: Mareep deserves a trainer who can keep it safe.
ja: メリープには、ちゃんと守ってあげられるトレーナーがふさわしいわ。

key: And right now, with all this destruction around us... I don't know if that trainer is me.
en: And right now, with all this destruction around us... I don't know if that trainer is me.
ja: それに今、こんなに街が荒れている中で……その役目が私に務まるのかどうか、わからないの。

key: So I think it's best if Mareep stays with you.
en: So I think it's best if Mareep stays with you.
ja: だから、メリープはあなたと一緒にいるのが一番だと思うの。

key: Show it the world for me, okay?
en: Show it the world for me, okay?
ja: 私の代わりに、世界を見せてあげてね?

key: Take good care of Mareep, okay?
en: Take good care of Mareep, okay?
ja: メリープのこと、大切にしてあげてね?

key: You beat that guy... Ah, thanks! He had caught me off guard and cornered me here.
en: You beat that guy... Ah, thanks! He had caught me off guard and cornered me here.
ja: あいつを倒してくれたのね……ああ、ありがとう! 不意をつかれて、ここに追い詰められてたの。

key: I'd better get back to work, the others must be worried. Be seeing you!
en: I'd better get back to work, the others must be worried. Be seeing you!
ja: そろそろ仕事に戻らなきゃ、みんな心配してるだろうし。またね!

key: GRUNT: Hey, back off!
en: GRUNT: Hey, back off!
ja: したっぱ: おい、下がってろ!

key: Wait a sec. I remember you, you're the brat from Peridot.
en: Wait a sec. I remember you, you're the brat from Peridot.
ja: 待てよ。お前、覚えてるぜ、ペリドットのガキだろ。

key: It's payback time!
en: It's payback time!
ja: 借りを返す時間だ!

key: Twice?
en: Twice?
ja: 二度目か?

key: Not again!
en: Not again!
ja: またかよ!

key: You're infuriating! Get out of my way!
en: You're infuriating! Get out of my way!
ja: ムカつく奴だな! どけよ!

key: Ah dear, so much to do here...
en: Ah dear, so much to do here...
ja: ああ、まったく、やることが山積みで……

key: We've got to rebuild somehow, but it's difficult to do so with the few of us that are left, and the mountain of obstacles before us...
en: We've got to rebuild somehow, but it's difficult to do so with the few of us that are left, and the mountain of obstacles before us...
ja: どうにか立て直さなきゃいけないけど、残された人数も少ないし、目の前の障害も山ほどあって……

key: I remember how easy everything felt when I was younger.
en: I remember how easy everything felt when I was younger.
ja: 若い頃は、何もかもがもっと簡単だった気がするわ。

key: Things were as simple as doing them.
en: Things were as simple as doing them.
ja: やることをやるだけで、それで済んだのよ。

key: No more, no more...
en: No more, no more...
ja: もう、そんな時代じゃないのね……

key: Say, Trainer, if you ever find yourself wishing for the good old days...
en: Say, Trainer, if you ever find yourself wishing for the good old days...
ja: ねえトレーナーさん、もし昔が懐かしくなったら……

key: ...Or perhaps if you just want things to be a little easier...
en: ...Or perhaps if you just want things to be a little easier...
ja: ……それとも、少し楽をしたいだけでも……

key: You could try telling someone "gen2mode" if they ever happen to ask you for a password.
en: You could try telling someone "gen2mode" if they ever happen to ask you for a password.
ja: 誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら、「gen2mode」って答えてみるといいわ。

key: A young person like you--
en: A young person like you--
ja: あなたみたいな若い人なら――

key: If you do that, maybe you can grow stronger in unexpected ways!
en: If you do that, maybe you can grow stronger in unexpected ways!
ja: そうすれば、思いがけない形で強くなれるかもしれないもの!

key: Young people like to find battles or trade on their Pokégear these days, though... and that certainly wouldn't be allowed if you did that.
en: Young people like to find battles or trade on their Pokégear these days, though... and that certainly wouldn't be allowed if you did that.
ja: もっとも今どきの若い人は、ポケギアでバトル相手や交換相手を探すのが好きみたいだけど……それをやったら、もうそれは許されなくなるでしょうね。

key: Make sure you're fine with that, first.
en: Make sure you're fine with that, first.
ja: まずは、それでも構わないか確かめておいてね。
